method: Track record compares what candidates said with what the official record shows they did. We take every position listed on this site, plus every promise in our said-vs-did file, and look for their own recorded action on the same subject: a roll-call vote, a bill authored, signed or vetoed, or an official act of their office. Each pair is marked consistent, inconsistent, or mixed/unclear by a written rule; reaching the goal by a different means counts as mixed/unclear. General-goal quotes are listed as not checkable. The score is consistent / (consistent + inconsistent), shown with its count, only when there are at least 3. Otherwise 'Not enough records'; never held office: 'No voting record'. Same rules for every party; all items link to sources.
